name: keepAwake
description: Lets coding agents keep a Mac awake during long builds, test runs and downloads, then let it sleep again. Holds are time-limited and end with the agent session. Off until you turn it on.
saferAlternatives: Turn off agent control in the keepAwake menu; the MCP tools then refuse new holds.
keep_awake is capped at 1440 minutes and every hold ends when the agent session ends, so a forgotten hold cannot keep the Mac awake indefinitely.
Use keep_awake_status to see which agent holds the Mac awake before granting more time.
